method.criteria: Full and short each tracked separately. Two additional useful works across held publishers with at least one OLMo target, preserve current by union, at most one extra genuine work per held panel. Useful needs 0.30 nonspace IoU and 0.50 target recall.
method.fit: Kubernetes only, source-balanced L2-regularized logistic contrast head on differences from matched original when present. Also fit one direct head on the labeled focus vectors to compare unpaired fit. Use native genuine donor substitutions as negatives. No reweighting by generator or outcome.
method.geometry: Full extracted articles and a separate three-sentence pasted excerpt with the center containing the known revision. Keep all eligible foci in each view and use actual neighboring context, with one sided coverage at file edges. Same geometry for all work variants.
method.head: Frozen primary encoder, mean final contextual token feature for focus minus mean matched contextual token feature for neighboring sentences. Pool over verified native token positions and ignore leading and trailing whitespace when deciding which sentence a token covers.
method.held: PLOS and eLife, publisher separate from fit and point. All known rewrites admitted before detector selection. Ordinary same-article donor and unchanged originals. Earlier project exposure for other methods.
method.incumbent: Current 0.5 raw direction and first six source-ordered native contexts; baseline control exact token center and unpaired margin with same frozen points.
method.point: F1000 published original and ordinary revisions only. Second-highest max positive response across the ten work groups, separate for each arm and input view. Strict excess and unique maximum.
method.runtime: CPU float32 native model, max 512 complete tokens, batch 6, seeds none. Logistic L2 fixed at one, fit covariance diagonal standardized with 0.20 minimum standard deviation.
